observations.label: initial
observations.controls:
- complementary:
  - button "Cleanup"
  - button "Collapse tool panel"
  - paragraph: Reduce colors
  - paragraph: Tighten the palette and optionally add controlled dithering.
  - group:
    - text: Images
    - button "Pick from gallery"
    - button "Paste from clipboard"
    - img
    - paragraph: Click to upload or drag and drop
    - paragraph: PNG, JPG, GIF up to 10MB
    - paragraph: Upload multiple frames to quantize them to one shared palette
  - group:
    - text: Colors
    - combobox "Colors":
      - option "Auto detect"
      - option "Number of colors"
      - option "Palette" [selected]
  - group:
    - text: Color palette (Beta)
    - button "SLSO8 (8) 8 colours":
      - paragraph: SLSO8 (8)
    - textbox "https://lospec.com/palette-list/sweetie-16"
    - button "Import"
    - paragraph:
      - text: Find one on
      - link "Lospec":
        - /url: https://lospec.com/palette-list
      - text: and paste its link here.
    - paragraph: Max colours
    - spinbutton "No limit": "2"
    - paragraph: Every pixel goes onto these colours. Max colours limits the image.
  - group:
    - text: Dithering
    - combobox "Dithering":
      - option "None"
      - option "2x2"
      - option "4x4" [selected]
      - option "8x8"
  - group:
    - text: Dithering strength
    - paragraph: "5.0"
    - slider
    - paragraph: Subtle
    - paragraph: Strong
  - button "Generate · 0.1 generations"
  - text: Auto-add to
  - button "Off"
